consecutive_path.missing: Reset held/breach/recovery held chain to zero; prior_adjacent_evaluable false
consecutive_path.same_day_revision: Same t-1 baseline; replace observation; held and breach never repeatedly increment

counter_definitions.missing_suspension: Cannot increment actual evaluable count; missing history yields UNKNOWN; breaks consecutive path counters
counter_definitions.pivot_left_count: Actual evaluable sessions preceding pivot_date, no shortened missing window
counter_definitions.pivot_right_count: Actual evaluable sessions after pivot_date through confirmation_date

post_creation_evaluable_sessions.definition: Count unique sessions after available_date with a qualifying evaluable D1 observation through observation_trade_date
post_creation_evaluable_sessions.missing: Suspension/missing/required coordinate unavailable adds zero; unavailable frozen count/history -> UNKNOWN
post_creation_evaluable_sessions.reset: New immutable Anchor only; NOT reset by missing
post_creation_evaluable_sessions.same_day_revision: Recompute date membership against same frozen t-1 baseline; never accumulate revisions; quality correction replaces membership

post_creation_market_sessions.definition: Count unique accepted calendar session_dates in (anchor.available_date, observation_trade_date]
post_creation_market_sessions.increment: Each market session including security suspension/missing

counter_definitions.same_day_revision: Same previous-session counter baseline; not another session
